World.title: Jenkins court martial to begin Nov 3
World.description: TOKYO (AFP) - The court martial of US Army Sergeant Charles Jenkins, accused of deserting to North Korea nearly four decades ago, will begin in Japan on November 3, the US Army said Thursday.
